card.name: Verbs right before our or us
card.fires_on: A verb or small linking word that sits just before an expected 'us', 'our' or 'ourselves' in running web text. The word itself is often makes, raised, subject, give, or to.

modes.label: Verb before our/us
modes.description: A verb whose object is a coming 'our' phrase or 'us'.
modes.example: if we do not<< give>> our body the energy it needs

modes.label: Linking word before our/my
modes.description: A short word like to or by that is followed by a possessive such as our or my.
modes.example: owe it<< to>> ourselves and to our hermanas to

modes.label: Verb after that
modes.description: A verb after 'that' where the next word could be 'us'.
modes.example: If an entire country is banning it, that<< makes>> it hard to ignore

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'us' and 'to us' type words such as 让我们 and 告诉我们 as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'us' or 'our' is likely to appear.
